title: Orion Camera View of Artemis II Parachute Deployment and Splashdown
description: GP011149 (April 10, 2026) - A view from a camera inside NASA’s Artemis II Orion spacecraft during re-entry. In this video, taken from the pilot’s forward window, Orion re-enters the Earth's atmosphere and parachutes deploy for splashdown. Credit: NASA
contents: Earth filling Orion's window shortly before re-entry, 2026-04-10.
